exercises.question: Which sentence makes the strongest claim?
options: Los datos demuestran que el efecto es real.
Todo parece indicar que el efecto es real.
Cabe suponer que el efecto es real.

exercises.sentence: Los datos ____ indicar que el efecto es mayor en los grupos pequeños.
exercises.english: The data seem to indicate that the effect is greater in small groups.

exercises.question: Which sentence limits the claim?
options: La tesis se sostiene en cierta medida.
La tesis se sostiene con los datos.
La tesis se sostiene en la muestra.

exercises.sentence: Cabe pensar que la muestra es demasiado pequeña.
exercises.english: It is reasonable to think that the sample is too small.

pairs: it is reasonable to assume that

exercises.question: According to the essay, what is the weak point of the case for working at home?
options: Isolation: people lose short conversations and the line between work and rest blurs.
Cost: setting up a home office is expensive for the company.
Distance: the journey to the office takes longer for those who live far away.

exercises.question: Why does the author distrust many comparisons between home and office workers?
options: Many use small samples or people who chose to work at home, which adds a bias.
Many measure only the quality of the result and ignore the time it takes.
Many include only companies that have stopped allowing work from home.

exercises.question: According to the essay, when do results tend to be better?
options: When the work has clear objectives.
When the work is done at home.

prompt.speaker: Carlos
prompt.text: ¿Está demostrado que trabajar desde casa mejora los resultados?

prompt.speaker: Meg
prompt.text: No del todo. _____ que sí los mejora, pero la muestra es pequeña.

template.prompt: Say it is reasonable to think that the effect is real.
template.answer: Cabe pensar que el efecto es real.

template.prompt: Say the thesis holds only up to a point.
template.answer: La tesis se sostiene hasta cierto punto.

template.prompt: Warn that you should not generalise from such a small sample.
template.answer: No conviene generalizar con una muestra tan pequeña.

exercises.sentence: Los resultados ____ a mejorar cuando el trabajo tiene objetivos claros.
exercises.english: Results tend to improve when the work has clear aims.
